name: spend-guardrails
description: Choose the lowest-cost current Claude or OpenAI model that can reliably do the work, without recommending retired models.

interface.shortDescription: Choose the cheapest current model that holds
interface.longDescription: Spend Guardrails selects across current Anthropic Claude and OpenAI models, verifies exact IDs, prices, and lifecycle status against official sources, and withholds unverified IDs when those sources are unavailable. It pins economical models on bounded workers, requires evidence before escalation, and avoids deprecated or retired models.
defaultPrompt: Which current AI model should this task use?
Design a cost-aware model mix for these agents.
Is this workflow pinned to a deprecated or retired model?
